certificatepath.description: Path to the client certificate file. Redefined by X509_USER_CERT env var.

keypath.description: Path to the client secret key file. Redefined by X509_USER_KEY env var.

cacertificatesdirectory.description: Path to the CA certificates directory. Redefined by X509_CERT_DIR env var.

causesystem.description: Use default CA layout of OpenSSL (system). 1/true or 0/false. Redefined by X509_CERT_POLICY.

proxypath.description: Path to the proxy certificate file. Redefined by X509_USER_PROXY env var.

vomsespath.description: Path to VOMS configuration file or directory. Redefined by X509_VOMS_FILE and X509_VOMSES.

defaultvoms_list.description: List of default VOMS settings for proxy certificate generation.

rejectdiscovery_list.description: List of FQDNs/URLs of services to reject during discovery.

rejectmanagement_list.description: List of FQDNs/URLs of CEs to skip during job management.

brokername_arg_override.description: Override for brokername in the brokerarguments section (used as a dummy key for the arguments line).

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for service responses.

joblist.description: Path to the jobs database file.

joblisttype.description: Type of backend for the jobs database (SQLITE or XML).
